name: Orc

traits.name: Bloodrage
traits.description: +15% damage dealt while below 50% HP (checked when the action resolves).

traits.name: Thick Hide
traits.description: +5 Defense, counted as armor Defense (Endurance stacks on top). Never wears.

effects.note: counted as armorDefense, not attribute Defense

traits.name: Intimidating
traits.description: Warcry-school and Fear effects the Orc applies last 20% longer; fodder-role enemies have a 10% chance to lose their first action in a fight the Orc opens.

effects.note: durations of effects the holder applies from the Warden's Warcry school ×1.20; Fear is covered by the rule knob

traits.name: Dark-steady Aim
traits.description: Ignores whatever Accuracy penalty heroes take in Dark and Pitch light.

traits.name: Noisy
traits.description: +5% chance for the whole party to be ambushed; merchants charge 10% more (after Haggling); −10% XP on Wisdom-tagged actions; −2 Detection in Radiant light.

creationBlurb: Marcher clan-folk. Hits hardest, and hardest of all when hurt.
